## settings.json keys

- `skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt` — unsafe default for a new user
- `enabledMcpjsonServers` — names dropped MCP servers

- `model/effortLevel/voice/remoteControlAtStartup` — personal preferences, not kit defaults
- `permissions.allow entries for dropped MCPs and Windows commands` — task-scheduler, process-list and curl-alias entries have no macOS meaning
